name: Get List Member Activities
description: Get the last 50 events of a member's activity on a specific list. [See docs here](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/list-activity/view-recent-activity-50/)

configurable_props.name: listId
configurable_props.label: List Id
configurable_props.description: The unique ID of the list

configurable_props.name: subscriberHash
configurable_props.label: Subscriber hash
configurable_props.description: The MD5 hash of the lowercase version of the list member's email address. This endpoint also accepts a list member's email address or contact_id.

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Fields
configurable_props.description: A string list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

configurable_props.name: excludeFields
configurable_props.label: Exclude Fields
configurable_props.description: A string list of fields to exclude_fields. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

configurable_props.name: action
configurable_props.label: Action
configurable_props.description: A comma separated list of actions to return. Possible values: abuse, bounce, click, open, sent, unsub, or ecomm.
